_readme: Canonical topic/page-number index for CA Inter Advanced Accounting. Source: 'CA INTER ADV ACCOUNTS - For Adarsh.csv' (400 topics, 36 chapters, page numbers as printed in ICAI study material). IDs normalized to hyphens (M2-C5-U2) and U0 for single-unit chapters (matches file 0's unique_chapter_id convention exactly, enabling direct joins). teaching_sequence/chapter_name_short/marks_distinct_attempt_count cross-referenced from 0-ca-inter-adv-accounts-subtopics-marks-weightage.json (locked, never edit) by unique_chapter_id. standard/standard_title parsed from unit_name where the unit names an AS (null for Companies-Act-based chapters). This file is the canonical topic-numbering + page-number authority for question-bank tagging going forward.
